text: Astronomy is a vast and fascinating field that explores the universe, including the birth of stars and the distribution of celestial objects. One of the most significant discoveries in this field is the formation of nebulae, vast, interstellar clouds of gas and dust that can be observed through telescopes. These nebulae are often the birthplaces of new stars and can be found throughout the universe, with some nebulae being the remnants of supernovae explosions.
